name: Chang & Sun: Core Content Factory (brief → publish)

parameters.content:
## Chang & Sun Content Factory: CORE workflow
**What it does:** claims 1 brief per run and produces 1 finished, compliance-checked, QA'd video, then packages it for 6 platforms and schedules the posts. A separate tick in the same workflow publishes due posts.

**Chain:** brief → script (Claude) → regex pre-scan + compliance judge (Claude) → revise loop (max 2) → shot plan → keyframes (Nano Banana via fal) → video shots (Kling 3.0 / Seedance 2.0 / Wan via fal) → voice (ElevenLabs v3 + timestamps) → lip-sync (InfiniteTalk via WaveSpeed) → assemble (Remotion/ffmpeg worker) → deterministic QA + vision QA → route (auto / approval / regen / human) → packaging + compliance pass 2 → variants → posts.

**Run mode:** self-hosted n8n in **queue mode** (Redis + 3–6 workers, concurrency 10). Every 2-min tick claims one brief with `FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED`, so parallel executions never collide.

**Settings → Error workflow:** point it at this workflow (Section D, Error Trigger). If your n8n version won't allow self-reference, move Section D to its own workflow.

### Credentials to create (placeholders in JSON)
- **Supabase service (apikey + Bearer)**: Custom Auth JSON `{"headers":{"apikey":"<service>","Authorization":"Bearer <service>"}}`
- **Supabase (service role)**: native node credential
- **Anthropic x-api-key**, **fal.ai Authorization: Key …**, **WaveSpeed Authorization: Bearer …**, **ElevenLabs xi-api-key**
- **Cloudflare R2 (S3 API)**: endpoint `https://<acct>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com`, region `auto`, force path style
- **Render/QA worker X-Worker-Token**, **upload-post Authorization: Apikey …**

### Env vars (self-hosted; set N8N_BLOCK_ENV_ACCESS_IN_NODE=false)
SUPABASE_URL, R2_BUCKET, R2_PUBLIC_BASE, RENDER_WORKER_URL, QA_WORKER_URL, COMPLIANCE_WORKER_URL (optional, defaults to QA_WORKER_URL), SITE_BASE_URL, SLACK_WEBHOOK_URL, REVIEW_APP_URL, REVIEW_WEBHOOK_SECRET, MODEL_WRITER (claude-sonnet-5-5), MODEL_JUDGE (claude-opus-5-5), MODEL_FAST (claude-haiku-4-5), GRAPH_API_VERSION (v24.0)

**Verify model endpoint IDs and param names** against each provider's model page before go-live. They are centralized in the `MODELS` maps inside the Build* Code nodes.

**On import:** set Settings → Error workflow (settings.errorWorkflow is a placeholder, REPLACE_WITH_THIS_WORKFLOW_ID). Set WORKER_TOKEN on the workers; the credential 'Render/QA worker X-Worker-Token' must carry the same value (workers fail closed without it).

parameters.content:
### A. Script + compliance (SAFETY_RULES.md checker pass 1)
1. The **regex pre-scan** (blocked_claims.json merged with SAFETY_RULES §3.1) runs first and deterministically. It can downgrade an LLM `pass` but never upgrade a fail.
2. The **Compliance Judge** (Opus, temperature 0) checks claims against EVIDENCE.md IDs, movement safety, disclosure and market rules.
3. `revise` loops back to the writer with numbered feedback, up to 2 revisions. After that the script goes to `human`.
4. `block` / `human` → brief status, then Slack with a review link. **No render money is spent until a script passes.**

### B. Shot plan → keyframes → video shots (async queue + poll loops)
- **Keyframes:** Nano Banana 2 (lean/standard) or Pro (premium), always with character reference images. Never text-to-image for characters.
- **gen_scene:** Wan 2.2 (lean) → Kling 3.0 Std (standard) → Seedance 2.0 (premium). Props, food and cutaways only.
- **motion_transfer:** Kling Motion Control using a **real performer driving video** from `assets` (signed release). This is the only route allowed for exercise demos.
- Each loop is **Submit → Wait → Poll → Check (merge by index, `$runIndex` timeout) → IF ready**. A failed or timed-out job throws, the Error workflow logs it to `job_failures` and requeues the brief (max 3 attempts), and the next attempt can use a fallback provider (`brief.fallback_level`).
- Swap to **fal webhooks** (`?fal_webhook=`) + a Wait node "resume on webhook" to cut executions at 10+ pages.

parameters.content:
### C. Voice → lip-sync → assemble → QA
- **Voice:** one ElevenLabs v3 call per line (`/with-timestamps`). Word timings drive the captions. Designed voices only, never cloned from real people.
- **Assembler worker** (Remotion on Lambda, or an ffmpeg box): timeline, word-level high-contrast captions, PiP, graphics, music ducking, −14 LUFS, **C2PA re-sign** (ffmpeg strips manifests), 12 QA frames, pHash sequence and Chromaprint.
- **Deterministic QA worker:** ArcFace similarity vs the reference centroid, SyncNet, EBU R128, OCR caption CER, black/freeze detect, ffprobe spec, C2PA presence.
- **Vision QA** (Claude): anatomy, props, gibberish text, exercise form, brand safety. The worst of the two verdicts wins.
- **Routes:** `auto` (pass + trusted page + green) · `approval` (packaged as drafts, human approves) · `regen` (requeue, max 3) · `human` (fail x3).

parameters.content:
### Human review (review app / Slack button → webhook)
POST `/webhook/review-decision` with header `X-Review-Secret` and body `{video_id, decision: approved|rejected|fix_requested, reviewer, notes}`.
- `approved` → drafts become `scheduled` (at least now + 10 min)
- `rejected` → posts deleted, brief cancelled
- `fix_requested` → brief requeued with the notes (same idea, new render)
**SLA:** queue cleared at 10:00 and 16:00 local. Production runs D-1, so a video approved late still makes its slot.

### P. Publisher (every 5 min, one post at a time via Loop)
`claim_due_posts` enforces status, due time, account status (warming/active) and **min spacing per platform**. Tokens come from **Supabase Vault** (`get_publish_token`). The Token-Refresher workflow (not shown) rotates IG/FB 60-day tokens, TikTok 24 h tokens + 365-day refresh tokens, and Google OAuth.
- **Instagram** (official Graph API): REELS container → wait → media_publish (retries cover 'media not ready'). Extra slots go out as **Trial Reels** (`trial_params`).
- **TikTok** (official Content Posting API, audited app): `PULL_FROM_URL` (verify the R2 domain in the TikTok portal), `is_aigc: true`, `brand_organic_toggle: true`.
- **YouTube** (official Data API): resumable upload with `status.containsSyntheticMedia: true`. Quota is **100 uploads/day per GCP project**, so shard accounts across projects (`gcp_project_shard`).
- **Everything else** (Facebook Reels, Threads, X): upload-post API. Verify field names at docs.upload-post.com. Move FB/Threads to official endpoints once Meta app review is done.
- Publish nodes use *continue on error*. `mark_post_result` retries 3× with 15-minute backoff, then marks `failed`.

parameters.content:
### D. Error workflow (set Settings → Error workflow = this workflow)
Any thrown error (a provider failure, poll timeout, JSON parse failure, missing asset) lands here. `log_failure` finds the brief by `claimed_by = execution id`, writes `job_failures` (the dead-letter queue) and requeues the brief (max 3 attempts, priority +10). Slack gets a one-line alert.
**Circuit breaker:** the Ops workflow (not shown) reads `v_provider_health_30m`. If a provider's failure rate is above 20%, it sets `pages.page_dna.fallback_level` so the Build* nodes route to the fallback provider.
